one_month_reasoning: In the window: Q1 FY27 results Wed 2026-11-04 after the close (guide $2.2-2.4B, non-GAAP EPS 1.85-2.05; our 2,370 / 2.07; Street 1.97 company basis) and the annual meeting 2026-11-18 (DEF 14A). The record is 4 of 4 above the revenue midpoint, but the stock's reaction to beats has been poor (-5% after the Aug-26 beat-and-raise [21]; the Aug-25 print fell ~19% pre-market), so a beat is expected and not a signal. After a -47% drawdown from the June high and a ~16% fall in the five days to 11-02, short-horizon reversal and a slightly positive earnings drift roughly offset continued momentum selling in AI optics. I centre the month at ~$211 (flat) with a 24% one-month sigma (89% annual / 3.5 = 25%, earnings inside the window, trimmed slightly because October's realized vol was crash-inflated); no directional call.

fair_value.method: Engine value of the driver-led set: 0.7 x NTM P/E 19.1x on the build's company-basis EPS ~$14.19 at the horizon plus +$6.1 Marvell-Lumentum post-NTM adjustment (= $277.08) and 0.3 x mid-cycle EPS $11.00 x 22.5x + 6.1 (= $254) -> $270.15.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM (Nov-27 to Oct-28) EPS ~$14.19 from the quarterly build (FY28 revenue 13,887, op income 3,419; tax 19%; 204.9M shares) x 19.1x (peer median 22.1x, own 20.6x, k=0.8, basis x0.937, -0.5 turn) + 1,256 $M share-shift adjustment / 204.9M

inputs_detail.derivation: Kept as in the proposed set: D&C revenue (Ex.99.1 Table 5: 1,090.0/1,208.0/1,361.6/1,615.0 FY26) / LightCounting AI-cluster Ethernet optics market (constant mkt, FY26 24,984 -> FY29 94,206). Q1 FY27 D&C 1,935 from the guide record (+3% on the 2,300 midpoint less Industrial 435); then +12/+10/+9% q/q in FY27, +5.8%/q FY28, +4.0%/q FY29. Base-rate view: capture falling 21% -> 15% already builds share loss to competing capacity (Innolight/Eoptolink, LITE) and CPO; I do not add more in the base. The standing AI-capex base (2027 +50%, 2028 +22%) sits below the LightCounting optics series (CY27 +76%), so the market constant leans high; capture absorbs part of that.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Downside (P10) -30% capture, a 2019-type digestion (LightCounting Ethernet -18% in 2019) landing in FY28; upside +22% if InP doubling and NVIDIA commitments let COHR hold FY27 capture. Each +/-10% moves EPS ~+/-9.8% (set notes).

inputs_detail.derivation: Kept: D&C segment profit / revenue from the 10-Q/10-K segment notes (24.7/25.4/25.5/25.2% FY26 quarters); +1.5-2.3pt on InP fixed-cost absorption and 1.6T mix. Base-rate check: FY26 total non-GAAP op margin 20.5% (1,456.9/7,118.2) is the only full post-realignment year; the build's 24.6% FY28 total margin is a peak-type margin, which is why 30% of the target sits on a mid-cycle leg at 20.5%.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Flat at 25.2% gives FY28 EPS -6.1% (set notes); downside -3pt, upside +2pt.

inputs_detail.derivation: Kept: Industrial revenue ex divested A&D/Munich (~107 FY26) grows ~+4% organic FY27, +5% FY28-29. Base-rate: Industrial lasers/materials are tied to the industrial and semicap cycle; Kalshi 2027 US recession 20% [11] is carried in the downside (-10%).
Kept: Industrial segment profit / revenue (23.7/23.4/22.7/21.8% FY26 quarters, FY25 19.8%); 22.5-23% sits between the FY25 and FY26 levels.

inputs_detail.value: FY26 24,984; FY27 49,835; FY28 74,307; FY29 94,206 ($M, LightCounting AI-cluster Ethernet optics mapped to COHR fiscal years)
inputs_detail.derivation: As gated in the set (LightCounting series CY25 16.5B, +120% CY26, +76% CY27, CY28 83.4B, CY29 106.05B). Cross-check vs standing AI-capex base: total customer AI capex 1,225 / 1,841 / 2,255 ($B, 2026-28), i.e. +50% in 2027 and +22% in 2028; the optics series grows faster (optics intensity rising with 1.6T and scale-out). Not changed; the downside carries the capex low case (2028 1,265, -44% vs base).
inputs_detail.variant_view: If optics only grew with capex (+50%/+22%), FY28 D&C would be ~15% lower at constant capture.

inputs_detail.input: horizon P/E (NTM, engine EPS ex-SBC, company non-GAAP basis)
inputs_detail.derivation: Whole-company peer median NTM P/E (peers.md, Zacks consensus basis): FN 18.9, AAOI 19.7, CRDO 22.1, CIEN 28.4, GLW 29.5 -> 22.1x. COHR own NTM on the same basis: 210.41 / (0.655 x FY27 8.71 + 0.345 x FY28 13.07 = 10.21) = 20.6x. k = 0.8: 22.1 x (20.6/22.1)^0.8 = 20.9x on Zacks-basis EPS. The engine EPS is company non-GAAP (Zacks prints COHR ~0.2-0.27/qtr lower, set notes): at horizon NTM EPS ~14.2, Zacks basis ~13.3, ratio 0.937 -> 19.6x. Less 0.5 turn for post-horizon risks (long_dated_risks) = 19.1x. Base-rate check: COHR's own 5-year median forward P/E 26.5x (Zacks, 2026-09-03) and valueinvesting.io forward range 23.3-37.7x; 19.1x on company basis = ~20.4x Zacks basis, below the own-history median because the horizon year is peak-type margin.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Own-history anchor (26.5x Zacks basis -> ~24.8x engine basis) would add ~$80/share to the P/E leg; downside uses the 2022-23 trough area (-6.5 turns).

inputs_detail.input: adjustment: Marvell-Lumentum shift after the horizon NTM
inputs_detail.derivation: If close: run-rate op income +136/yr x (1-0.19) = 110.2 x p_close 0.75 = 82.6/yr after tax. Ramp FY29 24% (33/136), FY30 74%, run-rate 100%, steps discounted 1.25/2.25/3.0 years at an 11% cost of equity (judgment): 0.24 x 0.878 + 0.50 x 0.791 + 0.26 x 0.731 = 0.796. 19.1 x 82.6 x 0.796 = 1,256 (NTM window holds ~0 of it).
inputs_detail.variant_view: Low variant (Marvell neutrality, bundle takes COHR transceivers): run-rate -84 OI -> ~-780; high (Westfall realignment) +705 -> ~+6,500 (~+$32/share). Appraisal: no source quantifies a precedent share move.

methods.name: other
methods.inputs: mid-cycle: FY28 revenue x FY26 realized 20.5% non-GAAP op margin -> EPS $11.00 x through-cycle 22.5x (own 5-yr median 26.5x Zacks basis x0.85) + 6.1

inputs_detail.input: custom: mid-cycle EPS x through-cycle P/E
inputs_detail.derivation: Mid-cycle EPS: FY2028 revenue 13,886.9 (build) x FY26 realized non-GAAP op margin 20.5% (1,456.9 / 7,118.2, Ex.99.1) = 2,846.8; less interest 1,103.8 x 5.7% = 62.9; x (1-0.19) = 2,254.9; / 204.92 horizon shares = $11.00. Through-cycle P/E: own 5-year median forward 26.5x on Zacks basis x ~0.85 (Zacks/company EPS ratio at FY26 EPS levels: 1.47/1.74, 1.21/1.41, 1.11/1.29, 0.93/1.16) = 22.5x. 11.00 x 22.5 = 247.5 + 1,256/204.92 = 6.1 -> 253.7.
inputs_detail.variant_view: At the build's own FY28 margin (24.6%) the leg would be ~$300.

downside.story: P10 ($120): an AI-optics digestion year lands inside the horizon NTM (FY28), like 2019 (LightCounting Ethernet transceivers -18%) on a much bigger base, with the standing capex low case (2028 1,265B vs 2,255B base) and Polymarket's 'AI downturn by 2027-06-30' (23%) as the trigger; D&C capture -30% (Chinese module makers and LITE capacity land as demand pauses), D&C margin -3pt (absorption), Industrial -10% (Kalshi 2027 recession 20%), Marvell-Lumentum low variant (~-$10/share vs base), and the P/E derates 6.5 turns to ~12.6x, the 2022-23 optics-trough area. Base rate: of 7 optical-name episodes since 2008 with the stock >=40% below its 12-month high, 3 fell a further 20-52% over the next 12 months.

base.story: The proposed driver build holds (FY27 revenue 10.9B, FY28 13.9B, FY28 non-GAAP EPS ~13.2, below company-basis Street ~13.9-14.1), Marvell-Lumentum closes with p 0.75 and a small late gain, and the market pays a k-shrunk peer multiple (19.1x company basis) on peak-type NTM earnings, with 30% weight on mid-cycle earnings. +28% from $210.41, against a base-rate median of about -12% (n=7, range -52% to +212%) for optical names a year after a >=40% drawdown: the build's earnings growth (FY28 EPS +34% on FY27) is what separates this from the 2017-18 AAOI and 2022 LITE/COHR episodes, which were demand and price-down cycles.

upside.story: P90 ($460): InP output doubles by Dec-26 and again in 2027 on time, NVIDIA and hyperscaler LTAs keep FY27-28 capture near FY26 levels (+22%), mix/absorption add 2pt, the Marvell-Lumentum high variant (customers dual-source away from Marvell, ~+$32/share if close) starts to show, and the multiple recovers toward the own 5-year median (26.1x company basis). Base rate: the same 7 episodes include +67%, +81% and +212% 12-month rebounds (COHR Dec-08, LITE May-19, COHR Oct-23).

Not padded.

thesis_break_reason: At $135 the stock would trade at ~9.5x the build's horizon NTM EPS and close to the 52-week low ($123.75, Nov-2025, before the NVIDIA agreement); that only makes sense if AI-optics demand has actually rolled over (hyperscaler 2027-28 capex cut toward the standing low case, a LightCounting-style down-year for 800G/1.6T) or COHR has lost 1.6T share/pricing, i.e. D&C capture well below the -30% downside. Ordinary volatility (89% realized) explains moves to ~$150-160; below $135 something fundamental broke.

reverse_dcf_check: 19.1x NTM company-basis EPS (~20.4x Zacks basis) at an ~11% cost of equity implies earnings growth of only ~3-5% a year after FY29 with the non-GAAP op margin fading from ~25% toward ~21% (mid-cycle) — plausible given the post-horizon digestion and CPO risks, conservative if AI optics keeps compounding at LightCounting's ~20% by 2031.

sbc_treatment.note: FY26 SBC 186.5 (cash-flow statement, F21; 193.8 in the Ex.99.1 reconciliation). The engine EBIT is company non-GAAP (ex-SBC) and SBC (2.5% of revenue) is deducted from FCF (sbc_treatment cost); the P/E is applied to ex-SBC EPS against peers on the Zacks basis (which for COHR prints ~0.2-0.27/qtr below company non-GAAP), with the multiple converted x0.937; shares grow +1%/yr for residual dilution. Counted once in the multiple conversion, not again in the share count beyond +1%.

reasoning: Lane: base rates. (1) Stock history: from Twelve Data monthly closes I took every episode since 2008 in which COHR/II-VI, LITE or AAOI closed >=40% below its trailing-12-month high: COHR Dec-08 (-57%) -> +67% next 12m; COHR Oct-22 (-54%) -> -12%; COHR Oct-23 (-42%) -> +212%; AAOI Oct-17 (-58%) -> -52%; AAOI Dec-18 (-67%) -> -23%; LITE May-19 (-40%) -> +81%; LITE Nov-22 (-48%) -> -22%. Median -12%, mean +36%, range -52% to +212% (n=7, overlapping, small). COHR today is -47% from its June close (394) and FN is -50%: a sector-wide de-rating, not a company miss (guide beats 4/4). The episodes that kept falling were demand/price-down cycles (AAOI 2017-18, 2022 telecom/China); the ones that rebounded had earnings re-accelerating. (2) Cycle base rate: LightCounting records optics down-years in 2009 (-4%), 2019 (-18%, the steepest on record) and 2023 (~-1%, Ethernet -10%) against 16% CAGR 2004-18 -> ~15%/yr unconditional, higher after an unprecedented doubling; Polymarket prices a 23% chance of an AI downturn (3 of 6 stress events incl. NVDA -50%, SOXX -40%) by 2027-06-30 and Kalshi 20% for a 2027 US recession. (3) Valuation range: COHR's 5-year median forward P/E is 26.5x (Zacks, Sep-26), forward range 23.3-37.7x (valueinvesting.io); today ~20.6x NTM on the Zacks basis. Model: I adopt the proposed quarterly driver set unchanged (its capture already falls 21%->15% and FY28 EPS 13.19 sits below company-basis Street), value it with a k-shrunk peer P/E (5 whole-company peers, median 22.1x -> 19.1x on company-basis EPS after basis conversion and a 0.5-turn post-horizon deduction) plus the Marvell-Lumentum post-NTM step (+$6.1), and put 30% on a mid-cycle leg (FY26 realized 20.5% margin, own through-cycle 22.5x) because the horizon year carries peak-type margins. Base $270 (+28%). Scenarios: sized so the distribution covers the base-rate dispersion: P10 $120 (digestion year + trough multiple ~12.6x, ~-43% from spot, matching the worst episodes), P90 $460 (+119%, matching the rebound episodes); the left tail is wider in log terms than the right (0.64 vs 0.42 sigma). Not driver-linked: the mid-cycle custom leg (revenue taken from the build by hand). Research limited to ~14 searches/fetches; X/Reddit not used.

model_inputs.ebit_basis_note: Company non-GAAP operating income (Ex.99.1 Table 6), excluding SBC, amortization of acquired intangibles, restructuring, held-for-sale impairments, gains on sale of business, integration/site consolidation and financing fees. downside.story: P10 ($120): an AI-optics digestion year lands inside the horizon NTM (FY28), like 2019 (LightCounting Ethernet transceivers -18%) on a much bigger base, with the standing capex low case (2028 1,265B vs 2,255B base) and Polymarket's 'AI downturn by 2027-06-30' (23%) as the trigger; D&C capture -30% (Chinese module makers and LITE capacity land as demand pauses), D&C margin -3pt (absorption), Industrial -10% (Kalshi 2027 recession 20%), Marvell-Lumentum low variant (~-$10/share vs base), and the P/E derates 6.5 turns to ~12.6x, the 2022-23 optics-trough area. Base rate: of 7 optical-name episodes since 2008 with the stock >=40% below its 12-month high, 3 fell a further 20-52% over the next 12 months.

upside.story: P90 ($460): InP output doubles by Dec-26 and again in 2027 on time, NVIDIA and hyperscaler LTAs keep FY27-28 capture near FY26 levels (+22%), mix/absorption add 2pt, the Marvell-Lumentum high variant (customers dual-source away from Marvell, ~+$32/share if close) starts to show, and the multiple recovers toward the own 5-year median (26.1x company basis). Base rate: the same 7 episodes include +67%, +81% and +212% 12-month rebounds (COHR Dec-08, LITE May-19, COHR Oct-23).

model_inputs.structure_note: Semis playbook, driver-led quarterly set adopted unchanged from the proposed thread set (drivers dc_capture, dc_margin, ind_rev, ind_margin; constants mkt, corp, lite_shift). Value carried by (1) the peer-anchored NTM P/E on the build's company-basis EPS at the horizon (weight 0.7; 19.1x) plus a Marvell-Lumentum post-NTM adjustment (+1,256 $M), and (2) a mid-cycle earnings x through-cycle P/E custom leg (weight 0.3; leg weights are judgment, untested). No DCF (not a neocloud). Base-rate lane: the scenario widths are set from optical-name drawdown episodes, LightCounting down-years and prediction-market odds.

inputs_detail.input: horizon P/E (NTM, engine EPS ex-SBC, company non-GAAP basis)
inputs_detail.derivation: Whole-company peer median NTM P/E (peers.md, Zacks consensus basis): FN 18.9, AAOI 19.7, CRDO 22.1, CIEN 28.4, GLW 29.5 -> 22.1x. COHR own NTM on the same basis: 210.41 / (0.655 x FY27 8.71 + 0.345 x FY28 13.07 = 10.21) = 20.6x. k = 0.8: 22.1 x (20.6/22.1)^0.8 = 20.9x on Zacks-basis EPS. The engine EPS is company non-GAAP (Zacks prints COHR ~0.2-0.27/qtr lower, set notes): at horizon NTM EPS ~14.2, Zacks basis ~13.3, ratio 0.937 -> 19.6x. Less 0.5 turn for post-horizon risks (long_dated_risks) = 19.1x. Base-rate check: COHR's own 5-year median forward P/E 26.5x (Zacks, 2026-09-03) and valueinvesting.io forward range 23.3-37.7x; 19.1x on company basis = ~20.4x Zacks basis, below the own-history median because the horizon year is peak-type margin.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Own-history anchor (26.5x Zacks basis -> ~24.8x engine basis) would add ~$80/share to the P/E leg; downside uses the 2022-23 trough area (-6.5 turns).

Through-cycle P/E: own 5-year median forward 26.5x on Zacks basis x ~0.85 (Zacks/company EPS ratio at FY26 EPS levels: 1.47/1.74, 1.21/1.41, 1.11/1.29, 0.93/1.16) = 22.5x. 11.00 x 22.5 = 247.5 + 1,256/204.92 = 6.1 -> 253.7.
